questions.stem: Water balance is controlled by a negative feedback mechanism. What does this mean?

options.text: The body always reduces the amount of water in the blood
ADH production increases continuously until all water is reabsorbed
A change from the normal level triggers a response that reverses the change
The kidneys send negative signals to the brain when water levels are low

questions.explanation: Negative feedback means that any deviation from the set point triggers a response that brings conditions back to normal. If blood becomes too concentrated, ADH is released to reabsorb more water; once levels return to normal, ADH release decreases.
